name: Versive
description:
Versive is the most flexible AI research platform: AI interviews, surveys, usability tests, and synthetic users in one place. Run surveys with more than 20 question types, AI-moderated interviews over text, voice, or video with adaptive follow-ups, and multilingual studies in dozens of languages.

This connector makes Claude part of your research team, with direct access to your Versive workspace:

Design and build studies. Workshop the approach in conversation, then let Claude do the building: create a study, add questions from Versive's full catalog (multiple choice, ratings, NPS, ranking, AI-moderated interview questions, and more), organize them into groups with randomization, and set up screening and skip logic.

Edit and iterate. Reword or reorder questions, adjust logic rules, update the interviewer's welcome and closing messages, and change settings like response quotas on any study you have access to.

Analyze and report. Ask how a study is performing and get completion rates, drop-off by question, and answer aggregates. Pull real quotes from transcripts, surface themes, and generate findings and recommendations grounded in what participants actually said. Built-in prompts create structured research summaries and executive summaries, and because Claude connects to your other tools too, it can turn results into presentations, documents, or Slack updates for your team.

Humans stay in the loop: everything Claude creates appears in your Versive dashboard for review, and nothing reaches participants until you share the study link yourself. You connect with your own Versive account through OAuth, access is read-only by default, your organization role and each study's access policy apply to every request, and every action is audited and revocable.

Get started free at getversive.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Versive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Versive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getversive.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Versive MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Versive lists 26 MCP tools, including add_logic_rule, add_question_group, add_questions, archive_study, create_study, delete_logic_rule, edit_interview_message, edit_logic_rule, edit_question, edit_question_group, edit_study_settings, and export_study_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Versive?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Versive in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Versive requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Versive is developed by Versive. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
